soja.definition: n erect bushy hairy annual herb having trifoliate leaves and purple to pink flowers; extensively cultivated for food and forage and soil improvement but especially for its nutritious oil-rich seeds; native to Asia

sojourn.definition:
n. a temporary stay (e.g., as a guest)
v. spend a certain length of time; reside temporarily
sojourn.translation:
n. 逗留, 旅居
vi. 逗留, 旅居

sojourned.translation:
n. 逗留；旅居
vi. 逗留；旅居

sojourner.translation: n. 旅居的人, 逗留的人

sojourners.definition:
plural of sojourner
n. a temporary resident
sojourners.translation: (sojourner 的复数) n. 旅居的人, 逗留的人

sojourning.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Sojourn
n. The act or state of one who sojourns.
sojourning.translation:
n. 逗留；旅居
vi. 逗留；旅居

sojourns.definition:
n a temporary stay (e.g., as a guest)
v spend a certain length of time; reside temporarily
sojourns.translation: n. 逗留, 旅居( sojourn的名词复数 )

soju.translation: n. 烧酒（源于韩国的酒精饮料）
